Package index

Univariate filtering

Functions used to assess individual variables or features independently.

zscore()
Classical or Robust Z-Score
iqr_outliers()
Interquartile Range Method
directional_outlyingness()
Directional Outlyingness for Skewed Distribution

Multivariate filtering

robust PCA

Principal component analysis that resists outlying observations (and, for MacroPCA, outlying cells and missing values).

robpca()
Robust Principal Component Analysis (ROBPCA)
rospca()
Robust Sparse Principal Component Analysis (ROSPCA)
macropca()
Robust PCA for Cellwise and Casewise Outliers (MacroPCA)
predict(<specproc_robpca>) predict(<specproc_macropca>)
Scores and Distances of New Observations
plot_outlier_map()
Outlier Map of a Robust PCA
plot_cell_map()
Cell Map of a MacroPCA Fit

orthogonalization methods

Functions used to identify and remove unwanted covariance structures and sources of variance from the multivariate data.

osc()
Orthogonal Signal Correction
opls()
Orthogonal Projections to Latent Structures
o2pls()
Modified Orthogonal Projections to Latent Structures
direct_osc()
Direct Orthogonal Signal Correction
projected_osc()
Projected Orthogonal Signal Correction
y_gradient_glsw()
y-Gradient Generalized Least Squares Weighting
direct_orthogonal()
Direct Orthogonalization

Apply an Orthogonalization Filter to New Spectra

figures of merit

Net analyte signal of a multivariate calibration model, with its sensitivity, selectivity and limits of detection and quantification.

nas()
Net Analyte Signal and Figures of Merit
predict(<specproc_nas>)

calibration transfer

Functions used to to transfer a calibration model developed on one instrument to another instrument.

pds()
Piecewise Direct Standardization
glsw()
Generalized Least Squares Weighting

Plasma diagnostics

Electron density from Stark broadening (with the STARK-B database), excitation temperature from Boltzmann and Saha-Boltzmann plots, and checks of LTE, self-absorption and detector saturation.

nist_ionization_energy()
Ionization Energies from the NIST Atomic Spectra Database

Read Saved STARK-B Data
stark_table()

stark_width()

electron_density()

saha_boltzmann_plot()

mcwhirter_criterion()

saturation_summary()
